archetypes.name: timing-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Ledger binding crosses Cursor, Codex, flat review, and implement round layouts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the apply-coder timing changes for ledger resolution mistakes across round-N and flat review tmpdir layouts. Check that explicit --ledger handling and exported LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER do not break existing launcher behavior or skill context. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: gantt-window
archetypes.rationale: Renderer semantics changed from task min/max to round-window axes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the Gantt renderer's use of gw_start and gw_end for chart axes and title spans. Verify task clamping, no-task behavior, 25-row caps, cross-skill round windows, and CI/probe exclusions remain intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
